@Bettina, I couldn't set up the weekly digest yet. The scheduler rejected both the list and create requests because the Gateway has no credentials configured (`gateway cron.add requires credentials`). Nothing is scheduled, so nothing will post on Monday 19 October until that's fixed. Someone with operator access needs to configure the Gateway auth (`/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`). Once that's done, I can add the job: Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, posting in #coastal-team with a summary of #coastal-team and #coastal-random.

When it runs, the digest will leave out finance figures such as discounts, rates, prices, contract values, invoices and payment terms. Those stay out of the channel, so it will cover operational items only: dates, ticket numbers, contacts and open customer issues.
